About this item

  • PERFECT FOR ENERGETIC LITTLE FEET: Designed for growing feet, these sneakers offer a cushioned sole and snug fit—perfect as walking shoes for babies, toddlers, and kids who never stop moving. Lightweight for playground, school, or running fun.
  • EASY ON & OFF: The double hook and loop straps make these sneakers easy for little hands to manage—no laces needed. Ideal for toddlers learning independence. A top pick for busy mornings and on-the-go families looking for effortless toddler shoes.
  • DURABLE & EASY TO CLEAN: Crafted with quality leather from a Leather Working Group certified tannery, these sneakers stand up to daily play and clean up easily—ideal for toddlers who love adventures, and parents who prefer simple maintenance.
  • LOVED BY KIDS, APPROVED BY PARENTS: Thoughtfully designed to balance comfort, style, and quality—these well-crafted walking shoes tick every box. A smart pick for parents, and a favorite for toddlers who won’t stop moving.
  • OUTSTANDING TRACTION FOR ALL ADVENTURES: Designed with excellent traction, these sneakers are perfect toddler athletic shoes, providing superior grip on various surfaces, supporting active lifestyle and confidence in exploring their world safely.

From the manufacturer

  • Do these run true to size?

    Fit varies. Many customers say true to size, but a notable number report they run small. If your child is between sizes, has a wide foot/high instep, or you prefer growing room, consider sizing up.

  • How do I choose the right size using the chart?

    Measure heel-to-toe in inches/cm and match to the chart. If your child is near the upper end of a size range, size up.

  • Are these good for wide feet or high insteps?

    Some wide-foot or high-instep kids do well thanks to the adjustable strap closures, but if your child is wide and between sizes, sizing up can improve comfort.

  • Are they good for school and everyday play?

    Yes—customers frequently mention comfort, support, grip, and easy on/off for school routines.

  • Are they easy to clean?

    Many parents wipe them clean easily. Follow the care instructions to help keep lighter colors looking fresh.

Product Description

Let your little one step into style, comfort, and independence with the PUMA Kids' ST Runner Hook and Loop sneakers—a must-have for active toddlers and kids. Whether they're running wild on the playground, walking through the school hallways, or gearing up for outdoor fun, these sneakers are built to handle it all. Designed with a durable leather upper sourced from a Leather Working Group (LWG) certified tannery, these sneakers are not only stylish but also easy to clean—perfect for messy adventures. The soft, cushioned insole and lightweight design provide all-day support, making them ideal as toddler walking shoes, running shoes for girls and boys, or just everyday toddler sneakers. Parents appreciate how quick and easy the double hook and loop straps make mornings—no tying required. Kids can slip these on independently, giving them a sense of confidence and freedom. Beyond performance, these sneakers offer a playful yet clean look that works with any toddler girl outfit or casual toddler boy look. From first steps to fast sprints—these sneakers are made to move with them.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sneakers comfortable with good support and cushioning, easy to put on and off, and ideal for active toddlers. The appearance receives positive feedback for being super trendy, and customers appreciate their quality. The fit and durability show mixed results - while some say they run true to size and last a school year, others report they run small and fall apart after three months of wear. The Velcro system receives mixed reviews, with some finding it convenient while others note it doesn't reach around properly.

5 out of 5 stars
Calidad, confort y funcionalidad excepcionales para el uso diario infantil
Los tenis PUMA, para niños representan una opción muy completa y bien pensada para el uso cotidiano, destacando tanto por su diseño funcional como por la calidad de sus materiales y su comodidad general. Desde el primer contacto, se percibe una confección sólida y cuidada, propia de una marca reconocida en calzado deportivo. Uno de los aspectos más prácticos es el sistema de cierre con velcro, que facilita enormemente la autonomía de los niños. Permite poner y quitar los tenis de manera rápida y sencilla, asegurando al mismo tiempo un ajuste firme y estable. Esto resulta especialmente útil para el entorno escolar o actividades diarias, donde la practicidad es clave. En cuanto a la comodidad, ofrecen una experiencia muy satisfactoria. La plantilla acolchada proporciona una amortiguación suave que reduce el impacto al caminar o correr, favoreciendo un uso prolongado sin molestias. La estructura del calzado es ligera, lo que evita la sensación de pesadez y permite libertad de movimiento, algo fundamental en calzado infantil. Los materiales utilizados se sienten resistentes y bien seleccionados, con acabados que reflejan buena atención al detalle. Las costuras están correctamente reforzadas, lo que contribuye a la durabilidad del producto incluso con uso frecuente e интенсиво. Además, la suela de goma ofrece un excelente nivel de tracción, proporcionando seguridad en diferentes superficies como pisos lisos, patios escolares o exteriores. El diseño mantiene un estilo deportivo clásico de PUMA, con una estética moderna pero versátil, fácil de combinar con uniformes escolares o ropa casual. Esto los convierte en una opción funcional que no sacrifica la apariencia. Otro punto importante es su capacidad de mantener el confort durante largas jornadas. Incluso después de varias horas de uso, los tenis continúan siendo cómodos, sin generar presión excesiva ni incomodidad en el pie. En conjunto, se trata de un calzado infantil muy bien equilibrado, que destaca por su comodidad, facilidad de uso, resistencia y diseño atractivo. Una opción altamente recomendable para el día a día de los niños, especialmente para quienes necesitan un zapato confiable y duradero.

    These Puma ST Runner shoes are really nice overall. The quality feels good, the design is stylish, and the Velcro, hook-and-loop closure makes them easy for kids to put on and take off. They also seem lightweight and well made for everyday wear. Decent value for the money!

    The biggest issue is the sizing—they run small. I ordered a size 13 for my 5 year old grandson and he had very little room without his feet pushing right at the front. He’s normal size is a 13, therefore I would definitely recommend sizing up, especially if your child needs a little extra room for comfort or growth. Overall, a nice-looking, good-quality shoe, but the sizing is something to keep in mind when ordering.

About this Item

  • PERFECT FOR ENERGETIC LITTLE FEET: Designed for growing feet, these sneakers offer a cushioned sole and snug fit—perfect as walking shoes for babies, toddlers, and kids who never stop moving. Lightweight for playground, school, or running fun.
  • EASY ON & OFF: The double hook and loop straps make these sneakers easy for little hands to manage—no laces needed. Ideal for toddlers learning independence. A top pick for busy mornings and on-the-go families looking for effortless toddler shoes.
  • DURABLE & EASY TO CLEAN: Crafted with quality leather from a Leather Working Group certified tannery, these sneakers stand up to daily play and clean up easily—ideal for toddlers who love adventures, and parents who prefer simple maintenance.
  • LOVED BY KIDS, APPROVED BY PARENTS: Thoughtfully designed to balance comfort, style, and quality—these well-crafted walking shoes tick every box. A smart pick for parents, and a favorite for toddlers who won’t stop moving.
  • OUTSTANDING TRACTION FOR ALL ADVENTURES: Designed with excellent traction, these sneakers are perfect toddler athletic shoes, providing superior grip on various surfaces, supporting active lifestyle and confidence in exploring their world safely.

Product Description

Let your little one step into style, comfort, and independence with the PUMA Kids' ST Runner Hook and Loop sneakers—a must-have for active toddlers and kids. Whether they're running wild on the playground, walking through the school hallways, or gearing up for outdoor fun, these sneakers are built to handle it all. Designed with a durable leather upper sourced from a Leather Working Group (LWG) certified tannery, these sneakers are not only stylish but also easy to clean—perfect for messy adventures. The soft, cushioned insole and lightweight design provide all-day support, making them ideal as toddler walking shoes, running shoes for girls and boys, or just everyday toddler sneakers. Parents appreciate how quick and easy the double hook and loop straps make mornings—no tying required. Kids can slip these on independently, giving them a sense of confidence and freedom. Beyond performance, these sneakers offer a playful yet clean look that works with any toddler girl outfit or casual toddler boy look. From first steps to fast sprints—these sneakers are made to move with them.
